title: Officer
jobDescription:
Location: Sangareddy, India Function: Supply Chain Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Planning: Raw material requisition to stores based on daily production plan. Implementing improvement plan on housekeeping and safety Plan overtime and leaves etc in consultation with brewing manager Help brewing manager to develop process improvement maps. Optimum process performance: ensure s mooth manufacturing, processing and filtration of beer in the shift as per the production schedule with set quality norms and quantity required. controlling beer loss at various stages within specified norms control raw material wastage, improve filter aid consumption. Maintain safe and healthy work environment: Identify and notify any safety hazards in the operation and ensure addressing it through the brewing manager. to ensure that all the protective equipment is given to and used by workers in the shift. Key Interactions: Internal: Brewing manager, maintenance engineer, packaging executives, QA executives, Stores in-charge External: Vendors and suppliers, as and when required. Qualification and Experience: BSc in Chemistry/Microbiology preferably with 2 years of work experience in the brewing industry. Candidates high on learning, agility and communication will be preferred. Ability to understand Hindi/English over and above vernaculars will be preferred. title: Shift Engineer
jobDescription:
Location: Sangareddy, India Function: Supply Chain Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance and productivity: Maintaining all the machines in plant to reduce the breakdown and achieve the budgeted targets Investigate problems with instruments and sensors including flow meters, variable speed drives, temperature sensors, pressure & level transmitters & SCADA. Carryout programming and configuration changes. In particular the development of the alarm settings, sensor limits, time schedules, temperature set points and control strategies. Investigate and recommend system improvements with particular emphasis on energy efficiency. To carry out preventive maintenance & continuous improvement of machineries as per the schedules. Quality: Make all the utilities available to maintain required quality standards of the plant. To maintain the ISO standards of the plant Efficiency: Automation of manual processes Ensuring proper and optimum utilization of plant and machinery and equipments. Maintaining the electricity consumption with in budgeted target. Reduce the break down of the machines by providing proper maintenance. Cost and cost control: To keep the repair and maintenance cost within budgeted amount. Control the usage of power in the plant. Safety and statutory compliance: Provide all safety measures in order to reduce Grievance of the accident (if occurs) Conducting periodic safety audits of Electrical Installation/panels. Self and subordinate development: To give on-the-job training to the subordinates. To identify training programmes for self. Development/ Expansion: Identify the areas which need improvement/automation and implementation. Preparation of estimates in respect of modernization, up gradation and new projects and inviting relevant competitive quotations from reputed suppliers and manufactures. title: Senior Manager Quality Assurance
jobDescription:
Location: Alwar, India Function: Supply Chain Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
A. Achievement of business objectives
1. Closely work with franchises
2. Support and achieve Operational Excellence in improving Product quality by implementing QMS on site. B. Quality Implement and follow Quality Manuals issued by CTC in all sites. No product recalls Ensure analyses are carried out with the frequency specified by BIS and UB in the units. Ensure quality parameters as per UB are maintained. Cross checking of chemical and microbiological analyses of product water. C. Maintenance of Records & Reports to CTC Maintain records of Raw Water and Finished Product analyses both internal and external. Highlight non-conformity to Unit Head/ QA manager. Follow up with the units to develop corrective & preventive action plan. Maintain records of Packaging Quality Index, quality complaints, Send Reports to concerned manager as per schedule given by CTC. Ensure that the units report on time. D. Manufacturing Facility Visits & Complaints Visit manufacturing facilities as per the given frequency. Send report to all concerned. Follow up with units to attend quality complaints within 48 Hrs of receipt of the complaint. Maintain complete records and close complaint within 7 days. E. Self & Subordinate Development: Give on-the-job training to site technicians (Chemist, microbiologist, process chemist). Arranging quality control awareness meetings time to time with site team comprising shop floor staff. Together with site technical team, train shop floor staff Identify training program for self F. Calibration: Follow up with units to calibrate and maintain all inspection measuring and test equipment. G. Others: To ensure proper running of the WTP (cleaning, sanitation etc.) Great experiences start with responsibility Access Restricted Unfortunately, due to your age or location we cannot let you enter our site at this time.
